description: Metadata for public Stanford Center for Research on Foundation Models pages on crfm.stanford.edu. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. The catalog stores the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text and PDFs are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Rights stay unknown unless the page states CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA and does not also state a restricted deed. A public page is not a licence. Stanford HAI pages are not included. This catalog is not a belief collector.
